trips.note: Afleverede Maria på hendes arbejde på Rigshospitalet, inden jeg kørte videre mod kontoret.
trips.justification: The note says the driver only dropped his partner at her own workplace, a hospital, so the trip is private even though it is a Monday morning during working hours.
A short midday hop from the office to a sandwich bar with the note 'Lunch alone' is a private lunch break, not a work meal, despite starting at the office in working hours.
The trip goes from the driver's home to the usual office (the same address that appears as the start of other trips) in the morning rush hour, which is a commute and therefore personal.

trips.end_address: Fitness World Østerbro, Østerbrogade 105, 2100 København Ø
trips.justification: Although the trip starts at the office on a weekday, the destination is a gym and the note says it is a workout, so the purpose is sport.

trips.end_address: Louisiana Museum of Modern Art, Gl Strandvej 13, 3050 Humlebæk
trips.justification: A Saturday-morning drive from home to a modern art museum has no work site or client in the record, so it is a leisure outing.
The airport run falls on a weekday but the note states the flight is for a holiday week, so the trip is private.

trips.end_address: Restaurant Kødbyens Fiskebar, Flæsketorvet 100, 1711 København V
trips.note: dinner w/ my sister, her bday
trips.justification: The trip starts at the office but ends at a restaurant for a birthday dinner with the driver's sister, with no client or work purpose.
A very short weekday-morning drive from home to a local train station with no client, site or work label is a private drop-off, not a business trip.

trips.note: Déjeuner seul au café du quartier, sans rendez-vous avec personne.
trips.justification: The note says the driver lunched alone at a neighbourhood café with no meeting, so it is a private lunch even though it starts at the office at midday.
The trip goes from the usual office back to the driver's home in the evening rush hour with the note 'Home', which is a commute and therefore personal.
